subject: ela
intro: Presentations are stronger with audio recordings and visual displays that help the audience understand the main ideas or themes. A visual (photo, chart, diagram, map) is seen; audio is heard. Good media match the topic and add information. Fourth graders choose helpful media for a presentation.

items.prompt: You are presenting about the layers of the rainforest. Which visual would help: a labeled diagram of the layers, or a photo of a race car?

steps: A good visual matches the topic.
A labeled diagram of the layers is about the rainforest.
solution.answer: A labeled diagram of the layers.

items.prompt: You present about different bird calls. What kind of recording could help the audience?

steps: An audio recording lets the audience hear the calls.
So an audio recording of bird calls would help.
solution.answer: An audio recording of the bird calls.

items.prompt: To COMPARE the heights of three mountains, which visual is best: a bar graph or a poem?

steps: So a bar graph is best for comparing heights.

items.prompt: Something the audience SEES in a presentation is a ____.
A good visual should ____ the topic.
